item.title: Eternal Materials braces for stronger 2026 but flags oil-driven cost monitoring
item.description: Eternal Materials expects operations in 2026 to outperform 2025, driven primarily by growth in precision equipment and scaling shipments of semiconductor advanced packaging materials. The company has increased raw material procurement to mitigate supply risks amid rising oil prices tied to Middle East tensions.

item.title: Why Switzerland chose a bottom-up approach over big tech grandstanding
item.description: During the 2026 World Economic Forum (WEF), Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang made an impassioned case for digital sovereignty. "Build your own AI, take advantage of your fundamental natural resource, which is your language and culture," he urged. "Develop your AI, continue to refine it, and have your national intelligence part of your ecosystem."

item.title: Rising costs and soft demand prolong smartphone panel slump; AMOLED prices to drop over 20% in 2H26
item.description: As March nears its end, the smartphone panel market has yet to see a post-Lunar New Year replenishment cycle. With upstream costs rising and end demand softening, overall market conditions continue to deteriorate.

item.title: DFI posts 15% revenue growth in 2025 but warns of tight CPU, memory supply in 1H26
item.description: Industrial computer (IPC) maker DFI saw profitability come under pressure in 2025 despite revenue growth, and expects CPU and memory supply to be tight through at least 1H26.

item.title: US-China trade tensions deepen as supply chains fracture despite tariff truce
item.description: The trade environment for US businesses operating in or trading with China deteriorated sharply between 2025 and 2026, according to a comparative analysis of the latest National Trade Estimate (NTE) Reports, underscoring a widening gap between high-level diplomacy and on-the-ground economic realities.

item.description: The 2026 National Trade Estimate (NTE) Report signals a new era of digital friction between the US and its closest Asian allies.

item.title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics lifts FC-BGA prices on AI-driven shortage
item.description: Samsung Electro-Mechanics has raised prices for its high-end flip-chip ball grid array (FC-BGA) substrates as demand from artificial intelligence (AI) servers and high-performance computing (HPC) applications continues to outpace supply, according to South Korean media reports and industry sources.

item.title: 2026 USTR Report: landmark
item.description: The Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) has designated Taiwan as a highly cooperative and pivotal trading partner in its 2026 National Trade Estimate (NTE) Report.
